hits.s: no issue with WOB transfer. TD was reached at 468m and high vis sweeps pumped before displacing the well to 1.4SG mud. There were no issues POOH. On surface all equipment was in good condition with 3mm play on the motor bearings. Gumbo around the stabilisers and bit was washed off from the platform cellar deck. MWD Run Summary Good run from reliability view point. QC logs revealed good tool performance during both ru

llision monitoring will be required until 850m. The assembly was made up in AUX and racked in derrick, so picked up from derrick and run in hole without issue. TOC was tagged at 450m and the hole displaced to OBM. There were no plugs in the 26” conductor. Cement and shoe were drilled with the following parameters: 4000lpm, 70rpm and WOB staged from to 8ton.
